project_type: React 18 SPA with Vite bundler and TypeScript
build_system: Vite with npm scripts; NODE_OPTIONS must be unset before running commands due to sandbox preload issue
build_command: unset NODE_OPTIONS && cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && npx vite build
test_command: unset NODE_OPTIONS && cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && npx vitest run
verification_instructions: 1. Run build command to confirm no TypeScript/CSS errors. 2. Run test command to confirm all 1094+ tests pass. 3. Verify new CSS files are properly structured.
environment_constraints: NODE_OPTIONS env var includes a broken preload path; must unset NODE_OPTIONS before running node/npm/npx. No docker daemon available for container builds.
contribution_requirements: CSS-only changes for animations/responsive. ARIA attribute additions to TSX components. No business logic modifications.
key_patterns: Design system uses CSS custom properties in :root (design-system.css). Layout uses CSS Grid (layout.css). Components use BEM-like naming (icon-rail__item, status-bar__item). All CSS imports go into main.tsx. Components use data-testid for testing. Existing transitions use var(--transition-fast) = 120ms ease, var(--transition-normal) = 200ms ease.
directory_structure: frontend/src/styles/ - CSS design system files (design-system.css, typography.css, layout.css, components.css). frontend/src/components/Layout/ - AppShell, IconRail, TopBar, StatusBar. frontend/src/components/ - feature components (BomPanel, SkuBrowser, ProjectCreation, etc). frontend/src/main.tsx - app entry point with CSS imports.
